title: leucas biflora
intro: Leucas biflora, commonly known as Bihu or Chirchira, is a plant species within the Lamiaceae family, traditionally used in various cultures for its medicinal properties. The plant has been reported to possess various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects, which can aid in the treatment of various ailments. The therapeutic actions of Leucas biflora include its ability to reduce fever, relieve pain, and exhibit immunomodulatory effects, making it a valuable resource in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of Leucas biflora include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and contribute to its therapeutic actions.
